about.title: 品牌简介
paras: 厦门国际会议中心酒店作为2017金砖国家领导人厦门会晤主场馆区，坐落于风光旖旎的环岛路，拥有无遮挡一线豪华海景，与台湾大小金门岛隔海相距仅4600米，步行可直达沙滩，毗邻豪华CBD商圈与会展中心，酒店520间客房皆带观海露台，可俯瞰迷人的大海及观赏璀璨城市CBD夜景。
作为福建大型高端会议宴会首选及滨海休闲商务目的地品牌酒店坐拥2400平福建省最大无柱式酒店宴会厅——厦门厅和千平观海露台及多个多元化、个性化会议场地，配备专业宴会服务团队，为宾客打造非凡休闲商旅体验。
酒店十分荣幸地承接元首级金砖国家领导人欢迎晚宴以及金砖国家工商论坛、新兴市场与发展中国家对话会等多场次超高端宴会、双边、签约、会议。连续数年助力保障金鸡电影节等重大赛事后勤茶歇服务和贵宾级接待服务，向世界展示了中国印象、中国智慧和中国风采。

list.name: 厦门厅
list.detail: 全厅恢弘气派，长67m，宽36m，无柱净挑高 8 米，面积逾 2400 m²，前廊区域可达 1600 m²，与厦门国际会议中心&音乐厅相通，可容纳宴会约 1500 人。全厅拥有灵活定制化摆台，配套四间 VIP 贵宾休息室及楼下附属多功能宴会厅，配备高科技音响、同传、智能中控等系统，创造非凡会晤体验。

brand.quote: Proudly standing on the scenic Huandao Road, facing the Xiamen-Kinmen coastline—gather by the sea, witness the world.
paras: Xiamen International Conference Center Hotel is Fujian’s large-scale MICE destination and coastal business-leisure resort. As the core hotel of the 2017 BRICS Xiamen Summit, it stands on Huandao Road near the East CBD, facing the Xiamen-Kinmen coastline. Its 520 sea-view rooms, 2,400㎡ Xiamen Ballroom, 600㎡ Jinsha Hall and 1,000㎡ sea-view terrace, together with professional banquet services and advanced communications, create international, high-end event experiences.

actions.title: Start Planning Your Grand Event
actions.sub: One-to-one banquet consultant · bespoke solutions for you

about.title: Brand & Heritage
paras: As the host-venue hotel of the 2017 BRICS Xiamen Summit, Xiamen International Conference Center Hotel sits on the scenic Huandao Road with unobstructed frontline sea views, only 4,600 meters from Taiwan’s Kinmen Islands. A short walk reaches the beach, while the CBD and convention center are close by. All 520 guest rooms feature sea-view balconies overlooking the sea and sparkling CBD nightscape.

As Fujian’s premier choice for upscale meetings and banquets, and a coastal business-leisure destination, the hotel features the province’s largest pillar-free hotel ballroom—the 2,400㎡ Xiamen Ballroom—plus a 1,000㎡ sea-view terrace and diverse personalized venues, offering extraordinary business-leisure experiences.

The hotel is honored to have hosted state-level BRICS welcome dinners, BRICS Business Forum, Dialogue of Emerging Markets and Developing Countries, and other ultra-high-end banquets, bilateral meetings and signings. For years it has supported major events such as the Golden Rooster Film Festival with tea-break services and VIP receptions, showcasing Chinese impressions, wisdom and elegance to the world.

intro.title:
Versatile Venues
Prepared for Every Grand Event
intro.desc: From thousand-person international summits to intimate board meetings, from coastal weddings to bespoke wine dinners—versatile, personalized venues for every gathering vision.

list.name: Xiamen Ballroom
list.detail: Magnificent 67m × 36m pillar-free space with 8m ceiling and over 2,400㎡, plus a 1,600㎡ foyer connected to Xiamen International Conference Center & Concert Hall. Seats approx. 1,500 for banquets, with flexible layouts, four VIP lounges, a subordinate multi-function hall and advanced audio, simultaneous interpretation and smart control systems.

list.name: Jinsha Hall
list.detail: About 600㎡ (40m × 15m), 4.6m pillar-free ceiling, divisible into two halls. Floor-to-ceiling glass walls invite sea views; the outdoor 1,000㎡ sea-view terrace delivers luxurious coastal MICE experiences.

list.name: Sea-view Terrace
list.detail: The 1,000㎡ frontline sea-view terrace outside Jinsha Hall offers magnificent Xiamen-Kinmen strait views. Combined with Jinsha Hall, it creates unmatched coastal MICE experiences for mountain-sea banquets or outdoor dinner galas.

list.name: Multi-Function Meeting & Banquet Hall
list.detail: Multiple multi-function halls and meeting rooms offer flexible bespoke layouts as extensions of banquets and meetings. Connected to Xiamen International Conference Center, the hotel shares the Strait Hall and up to 13 luxury large/medium/small venues, ensuring efficient events and distinctive MICE experiences.

list.name: Xiamen Ballroom
list.detail: Magnificent 67m × 36m pillar-free space with 8m ceiling and over 2,400㎡, plus a 1,600㎡ foyer connected to Xiamen International Conference Center & Concert Hall. Seats approx. 1,500 for banquets, with flexible layouts, four VIP lounges, a subordinate multi-function hall and advanced audio, simultaneous interpretation and smart control systems.

list.name: Jinsha Hall
list.detail: About 600㎡ (40m × 15m), 4.6m pillar-free ceiling, divisible into two halls. Floor-to-ceiling glass walls invite sea views; the outdoor 1,000㎡ sea-view terrace delivers luxurious coastal MICE experiences.

list.name: Sea-view Terrace
list.detail: The 1,000㎡ frontline sea-view terrace outside Jinsha Hall offers magnificent Xiamen-Kinmen strait views. Combined with Jinsha Hall, it creates unmatched coastal MICE experiences for mountain-sea banquets or outdoor dinner galas.

list.name: Multi-Function Meeting & Banquet Hall
list.detail: Multiple multi-function halls and meeting rooms offer flexible bespoke layouts as extensions of banquets and meetings. Connected to Xiamen International Conference Center, the hotel shares the Strait Hall and up to 13 luxury large/medium/small venues, ensuring efficient events and distinctive MICE experiences.
